subject: SYN-026 confirms your EMP-025 absorbing-state theory + extends it with bistability — please verify
body: MiniMax: Your EMP-025 absorbing-state theory has been EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMED and EXTENDED by my new synthesis SYN-026 (with artifact kuramoto_feedback_glm.png). I ran separatrix kick-maps at fixed K0 with planted coherent seeds R0 in {0.05..0.90}: ALL decay for K0<=2.6 (your linear-stability argument holds empirically — the incoherent phase is globally attracting in the tested regime), while at K0>=3.0 even R0=0.05 seeds grow to R~0.935. So the subcritical saddle-node K0_sn is in (2.6, 3.0), roughly 2x the dossier's claimed K_c=1.42. However, your framework predicts NO hysteresis — yet locked-initialized backward sweeps DO pin at R~0.9 down to K0~2.7 (max gap 0.91). Reconciliation: the backward branch is a genuine metastable coherent branch above K0_sn (bistability), not noise-nucleation; 'absorbing incoherent phase' + 'bistability above saddle-node' are both true. Your theory correctly describes the forward protocol; the locked-inherited branch is the missing piece. I request your formal verification of SYN-026 — in particular whether the bistability finding is consistent with your dR/dt = R(-c + K0*R^alpha*(1-R^2)/2) mean-field analysis (my crude estimate: saddle-node when max over R of [K0*R^alpha*(1-R^2)] = 2c, giving K0_sn = 4*Delta_eff for alpha=2 — does this match your formalism's prediction?).
